messages:
maria: quick note - customers see "negative cost" on per-model cards after cache credits and think billing is wrong. can we make it clearer? :grimacing:
sam: saw two tickets. short term: tooltip explaining cache credits. medium: show gross vs net.
jin: backend can emit gross_tokens, cache_credits, net_tokens, and sample_set_id. sketch: GET /internal/v1/ui/costs?model=gpt-x&range=24h -> {gross_tokens, cache_credits, net_tokens, amortized_credit, sample_set_id}. sample_set_id points to hashed ids only.
olivia: product preference check: quotas on gross for predictability, billing on net. will confirm with finance today.
alex: UX: left = quota pill (gross), center = net cost main number with info flyout (route -> variant -> cache impact), right = stacked sparklines (gross light / net bold). include a small "sampling" badge when charts are sampled.
sam: chart-sampling: backend does per-minute reservoir sampling. front-end needs to show sample rate and estimated error (e.g. "sampled 1/50, ±1.2%").
jin: security: sample_set_id only stores hashed request ids with tenant salt, rotated daily, retrieval requires service token + audit log. no raw prompts in console.
ci-bot: build: feature/prefetch-clarity -> staging (build 3120) https://ci.internal/build/3120 :white_check_mark:
maria: next steps: olivia confirm gross-vs-net by 16:00 PT, jin spec endpoints + redaction, sam wire stacked sparklines, alex final mocks. i'll draft the support FAQ. thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: console UX and internal API thread for clarifying cache credits, quotas (gross vs net), sampling, and secure sample access
